title: Totem villagers
description: Villager-themed totem with green eyes, bringing a fun and friendly vanilla Minecraft vibe.
body:
###  hello
____
This resource pack transforms the Minecraft totem into a villager-inspired design, giving the game a fun and familiar twist. Instead of the default look, players will see a small golden figure with bright green eyes, just like a villager’s signature style. The design is simple, recognizable, and adds a lighthearted touch to survival gameplay. When held or activated, the totem feels more playful and unique, making every save-from-death moment more entertaining. It’s a great choice for players who want to customize their world with a friendly, villager-themed vibe while still keeping the vanilla feel of Minecraft.
